_comment: John Wick (2014) shot catalogue. Stage 2 ACT 1 ONLY (grief -> the gift -> the theft/assault, ~00:00-00:16). Acts 2-4 to follow. Every shot FRAME-VERIFIED against frames/overview (4s density). depth_target: fuller_recap (aim 90-110 shots across 30 beats). depicts vocabulary per TAGGING_GUIDE; beat field links to beats_proposal.md. HOOK: B01 presents a dying man + Helen video as a mystery - do NOT pre-leak the Baba Yaga reveal (held to B10). CENSOR light (R-rated gunplay is stylized; dog's death is off-frame). NOTE: exposure_lift intentionally OMITTED - the repo default DARK lift is disabled (config.DARK_EXPOSURE_LIFT=0.0); JW's dark night look is deliberate and must not be washed out. Muc 3 capacity fields set to cut-aware windows; catalogue enrich may refine.

shots.action: COLD-OPEN HOOK: a black SUV skids to a stop at a night warehouse/waterfront; a battered John stumbles out, bleeding (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:00:52)
HOOK: John collapses against a low wall, gravely wounded, and pulls out his phone (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:01:20)
HOOK payoff: John watches a phone video of his late wife Helen as he bleeds out - who is this man, and why is he dying alone? (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:01:40)
Reset to the beginning: John's modern glass house; framed photos of John and Helen together; the quiet life he built (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:02:24)
the hospital: John at Helen's bedside as she dies of illness; he holds her, hollowed (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:03:08)
John alone with his grief after Helen passes - a single tear (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:03:52)
Helen's funeral in the rain: the casket lowered, mourners under black umbrellas at the graveside (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:04:16)
graveside: Marcus, an old friend, approaches John under an umbrella to pay quiet respects ('checking up on an old friend') (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:04:48)
John stands alone among the gravestones in the rain after the funeral, utterly hollowed (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:05:44)
night: a Kewlin delivery van at John's door; he signs for an unexpected crate delivery (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:06:32)
John reads Helen's handwritten letter under the lamp: her final gift, 'so you have something to love' (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:06:52)
John opens the crate: Daisy, a beagle puppy - Helen's last gift; he lifts her, the one thing pulling him back toward life (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:08:00)
morning: the puppy Daisy wakes John in bed, licking his face - a first breath of peace (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:08:48)
quiet morning routine: John makes coffee, two cereal bowls (one for Daisy), the puppy underfoot in the kitchen (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:09:36)
John, Daisy beside him, backs his classic 1969 Mustang out of the garage and takes it out to drive (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:10:08)
John opens up the '69 Mustang on an empty airfield at sunset - the joy of the life he is rebuilding (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:12:44)
the Chevron gas station: John fuels the Mustang; a car pulls in and Iosef Tarasov, hooded, gets out eyeing the car (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:10:40)
Iosef demands to buy John's Mustang; John refuses. Iosef's wounded pride - the spark that starts everything (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:11:20)
John drives off; Iosef watches, humiliated - 'who does this guy think he is?' (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:12:04)
DARK: night at John's house - John and Daisy asleep; the calm before the break-in (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:13:32; deliberate dark night interior, no lift)
DARK: the crew beats John unconscious on the floor of his home; Iosef stands over him ('shut that fucking dog up!') (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:14:12)
DARK: John left beaten and bloody on the floor as the crew leave with his Mustang; the puppy killed (off-frame) (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:15:00)
John wakes bloodied in the wreckage of his peace; morning after the assault (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:15:36)
John buries Daisy in the yard at dawn - a shovel, a small grave; something in him closes (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:15:48; silence-candidate, let the grief breathe)
John at the dawn waterfront, hollowed and silent - the grief hardening into something else (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:16:12)
Aurelio's blue-lit chop shop: Iosef brings the stolen Mustang; Aurelio recognizes it and confronts him (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:18:04)
Aurelio punches Iosef to the ground and throws him out: 'you stole John Wick's car, and killed his dog' - the first weight of the name (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:18:48)
Viggo Tarasov, the Russian crime boss, on a rooftop terrace at dusk - he phones Aurelio, not angry that he struck his son but asking WHY (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:20:04)
the candlelit Tarasov HQ: Viggo confronts Iosef at the bar - 'it's not what you did, son... it's who you did it to' (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:21:40)
THE REVEAL of who John was: Viggo's 'Baba Yaga' monologue - John was the assassin they sent to kill the boogeyman, who left the life for a woman (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:23:20)
in his emptied house at night, John sledgehammers his own concrete floor to reach a buried cache - the assassin re-awakening (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:24:04)
the buried case opens: rows of gold coins and a fitted arsenal - John's old life, unearthed and re-armed (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:26:24)
Viggo phones John directly - the two professionals speak; Viggo offers condolences and warns him off, but the choice is already made (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:26:44)
John showers off the blood (scarred back) and dresses in a pressed black suit - the Boogeyman fully remade (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:27:52)
DARK: knowing John is coming, Viggo sends a hit squad to John's house that night; masked men close on the dark glass house (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:29:04)
HOUSE FIGHT stage 1 (the breach): masked assailants pour in down the spiral stair; John meets them at the entry (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:29:20)
HOUSE FIGHT stage 2 (gun-fu, main floor): John drops attacker after attacker with precise close-range gunfire - the first full display of what he is (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:29:36)
HOUSE FIGHT stage 3 (through the rooms): John hunts the remaining men room to room, silhouettes and muzzle flashes across the dark house (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:30:20)
HOUSE FIGHT stage 4 (hand-to-hand): John grapples an assailant in the kitchen, brutal close combat when the guns run dry (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:30:48)
HOUSE FIGHT stage 5 (the finish): John pins and kills the last man on the floor, then rises alone and bloodied - the squad wiped out (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:31:12)
aftermath: a patrol cop arrives at the red-lit door on a 'noise complaint'; John, calm amid the carnage, sends him off (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:31:48)
John calls in a 'dinner reservation' and counts gold coins - introducing the assassins' economy and the Continental cleanup service (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:32:40)
Charlie and his 'waste disposal' crew arrive to quietly remove the bodies - the discreet machinery of John's old world (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:33:16)
Viggo, learning John survived, puts a two-million-dollar open contract on him - every assassin in the city is now a threat (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:34:28)
Marcus, an older assassin and John's old friend, in his own apartment - a calm domestic morning before the contract finds him (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:35:12)
Marcus takes Viggo's contract - 'consider it done' - but his intent is his own (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:36:00)
instead of hunting John, Marcus sets up as an overwatch sniper across the rooftops - loyalty positioned against the bounty (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:36:56)
John pulls up outside the Continental hotel in his black muscle car and steps out, suited, back in the life (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:37:40)
the Continental lobby: John checks in among fellow assassins (Ms. Perkins nearby); the house code and gold-coin economy are laid out (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:38:24)
in his Continental room John lays out his weapons; then moves down through the hotel, hunting - the predator on the move (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:39:36)
DARK: John enters the Red Circle nightclub, its crowd washed in green and red - closing in on Iosef (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:40:28)
at the Continental, Winston helps John find his target - 'Yosef Tarasov, I'd like to talk with him' - and reminds him he got out once (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:41:19)
DARK: John arrives at the Red Circle - the club's facade blazing red, green and blue neon; he walks in to hunt Iosef (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:45:34)
DARK: in the neon bathhouse Iosef's bodyguards spot John - 'are you scared of the boogeyman? / you should be'; John clears the club (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:46:30)
RED CIRCLE stage 1 (the baths): John drowns/kills a bodyguard in the blue bathhouse pools - 'you stole my car' - the hunt turns lethal (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:48:00)
RED CIRCLE stage 2 (through the club): John fights guards through the red-and-blue corridors and VIP rooms, gun and fist (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:49:16)
RED CIRCLE stage 3 (the dancefloor): wounded and bleeding, John shoulders through the packed crowd, still hunting Iosef among the strobing bodies (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:51:12)
RED CIRCLE stage 4 (the booths): John cuts down the last guards in the tufted VIP booths - the club a battlefield (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:51:48)
Iosef escapes the chaos in a speeding car; John, wounded, is denied the kill (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:53:28)
bloodied outside the club, John makes a call - relentless but hurt, the target slipped away (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:54:44)
back at the Continental, the house doctor stitches John's gunshot wound as he recovers in his room (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:55:44)
Ms. Perkins breaks the Continental's rules, slipping into John's room with a silenced pistol; a brutal one-on-one fight erupts across the room (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:57:36)
John overpowers Perkins and takes her alive, bloodied - a captive who has just violated the house code (FRAME-VERIFIED 00:58:48)
John interrogates the captive Perkins - 'do you really want to die here?' - and she gives up the Russian church where Viggo hides his stash (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:00:00)
CHURCH RAID stage 1: John enters the Russian church front and cuts down Viggo's guards among the pews and stained glass (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:01:16)
CHURCH RAID stage 2 (the vault): John forces the priest to open the hidden vault at gunpoint, shooting his way in to Viggo's cash and blackmail (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:02:24)
CHURCH RAID payoff: John torches Viggo's war chest - the cash and the leverage over the city, burned; he is dismantling Viggo's power itself (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:03:08)
STREET AMBUSH: leaving the church, John is jumped by Viggo's men on the street - the hand-to-hand breaks into a running gunfight (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:04:48)
the street shootout: John trades rifle fire with Viggo's crew around parked cars, then is finally overwhelmed and knocked out - captured (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:05:20)
tied to a chair in a warehouse, John faces Viggo - the two professionals talk; 'people don't change / times, they do'; 'finally, common ground' (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:07:12)
a distant sniper shot - Marcus, watching over John from a rooftop, kills the executioner and frees John to fight (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:10:44)
WAREHOUSE BREAKOUT: freed, John fights his way out through Viggo's men in the golden-lit warehouse, then out into the daylight street (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:11:12)
John runs down a fleeing Tarasov man at his car and forces Iosef's location out of him at gunpoint (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:13:12)
John and Marcus meet under the bridge - two old friends, the last quiet moment before the cost of Marcus's loyalty comes due (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:18:24)
Viggo's men are waiting inside Marcus's home; John, driving, phones to warn him - but Marcus already knows he is trapped (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:19:40)
Viggo's men beat and torture Marcus for protecting John - the old assassin battered but unbroken (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:20:36)
Ms. Perkins executes Marcus as Viggo watches - loyalty repaid with death; John's one true friend is gone (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:21:56)
John arrives too late and finds Marcus dead on the floor - he kneels beside his friend's body, the grief silent and total (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:23:12; let this land)
the Continental collects its due: Ms. Perkins, cornered in the underground hall, is executed by the house for breaking its rules - the world polices its own (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:24:00)
John phones Viggo directly - grief turned to cold purpose; Winston's code quietly points him to where Viggo is fleeing (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:24:24)
John hits the shipyard where Viggo's convoy is fleeing to a helicopter; a firefight erupts across the wet docks - 'I knew he'd come' (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:26:24)
John reaches Iosef in a car and finally kills him - the revenge that started it all, closed, as Viggo watches his son die (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:27:12)
with his son dead, Viggo flees and John gives chase - a running car battle through the dark docks toward the final reckoning (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:27:44)
the chase ends in a crash on the rain-soaked dock; both men drag themselves from the wreckage, spent and wounded (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:28:48)
in the pouring rain, guns and bullets spent, John and Viggo square off - 'no more guns, John... just you and me' - stripped to the two men themselves (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:29:12)
RAIN FIGHT stage 1: two exhausted men trade brutal blows in the downpour, grappling to the wet ground - no style left, just will (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:29:36)
RAIN FIGHT stage 2: Viggo pulls a knife; John disarms him and turns it, the fight grinding to its exhausted end (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:30:24)
the finish: John ends it, and Viggo falls - the war that took everything from him is over (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:31:36; let the beat land, do not over-narrate)
John stands alone in the rain, gravely wounded, and staggers away from Viggo's body - victorious, and utterly hollowed out (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:32:00)
John breaks into an animal clinic and stitches his own wounds - alone again, but alive, the way he began (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:32:48)
at the kennels John frees a dog from its cage - choosing, again, to have something to protect; something to live for (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:34:04; mirrors Daisy, the opening gift)
John and the dog walk off together along the same night waterfront where he grieved - not peace, but a reason to keep going (FRAME-VERIFIED 01:34:24; the quiet close, let it breathe)
